 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify the full-width separator row and the uniform background.
    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != grid[0][0])
    line_color = grid[sep][0]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # The lone object is all cells that are neither background nor separator color.
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] not in (bg, line_color)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not pts:
        return out
    rmin, rmax = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    cmin, cmax = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    obj = [(r-rmin, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in pts]
    # Clear the source object.
    for r, c in pts:
        out[r][c] = bg
    height = rmax-rmin+1
    if rmin > sep:
        # Bring the object to the near side below the separator; mark its far edge.
        nr = sep + 1
        for dr, c, color in obj:
            out[nr+dr][c] = color
        marker = nr + height
    else:
        # Bring the object to the near side above the separator; mark its far edge.
        nr = sep - height
        for dr, c, color in obj:
            out[nr+dr][c] = color
        marker = nr - 1
    if 0 <= marker < h:
        out[marker] = [8] * w
    return out
"
}
